areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Full thematic alignment: modernized school infrastructure, more enrolments, curricula and teacher training for technical education; most resources go to this area.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Resilient school buildings designed for extreme climate events; objectives, indicators, products and some resources meet the minimum criteria.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Actions integrating students into the green labor market (internships, micro-business support, partnerships); objectives, indicators and a relevant resource share.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Targets low-coverage, low-development municipalities with related objective and products, but related indicators and resource share are not well demonstrated.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Green-skills training has only long-term effects; no indicators, actions or resources directly and closely tied to conservation or restoration.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: No objectives, indicators, components or products focused on industry; actions are curricular changes to prepare labor supply.

not_accepted.name: Environment
not_accepted.reason: Green-skills training has only long-term effects; no indicators, actions or resources directly and closely tied to conservation or restoration.

not_accepted.name: Decarbonization
not_accepted.reason: No objectives, indicators, components or products focused on industry; actions are curricular changes to prepare labor supply.

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed all resources go to federal priorities, but the subsequent technical-vocational modality is not basic education, so actions are not exclusively focused on those priorities.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
